{{Quote|Manaan, the only source of the healing kolto in the entire galaxy, is a wonderful and refreshing place to visit or do business. The Manaan Port Authority welcomes beings of all species and affiliations to trade peacefully within the confines of Ahto City.|Manaan Visitor's Guide|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Manaan Port Authority''' handled the docking of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] including trade with off [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Behind the scenes==
Both the Manaan Port Authority and the [[Manaan Board of Tourism and Trade]] appear to handle trade on Manaan, so it is unknown if they are same organization or if they are separate.
